calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END p, st.store_id, st.store_name,
        f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31') OR (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25'))
SELECT store_id, store_name,
  sum(CASE WHEN p='prior' THEN net_amount END) prior_net, sum(CASE WHEN p='cur' THEN net_amount END) cur_net,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p='prior' THEN sale_date END) prior_days, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p='cur' THEN sale_date END) cur_days,
  sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff_lines, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code<>'ST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonST
FROM s GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END p,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl,
 min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads,
 sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonposq,
 sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END p, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) d,
 sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(CASE WHEN s.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.channel_code='WB' THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) web_refund
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25'
GROUP BY 1

WITH fs AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END p, st.store_id,
   sum(f.net_amount) gross_sales, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) nonstaff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE st.store_id<900 AND ((f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31') OR (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25'))
 GROUP BY 1,2),
fr AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END p, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE st.store_id<900 AND ((r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31') OR (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25'))
 GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN business_date >= DATE '2026-05-04' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END p, store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) b, sum(returns_net) r, sum(net_sales) n
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
 WHERE store_id<900 AND ((business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31') OR (business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25'))
 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT fs.p, count(*) stores, sum(fs.gross_sales) f_sales, sum(coalesce(fr.ret,0)) f_ret, sum(rp.b) rpt_before, sum(rp.r) rpt_ret, sum(rp.n) rpt_net,
  sum(fs.nonstaff) nonstaff
FROM fs LEFT JOIN fr USING (p,store_id) LEFT JOIN rp USING (p,store_id) GROUP BY fs.p

WITH per AS (
 SELECT 'cur' p, DATE '2026-05-04' a, DATE '2026-05-31' b UNION ALL SELECT 'prior', DATE '2025-04-28', DATE '2025-05-25'),
sales AS (
 SELECT per.p, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) s
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.a AND per.b
 WHERE st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
rets AS (
 SELECT per.p, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) r
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.a AND per.b
 WHERE st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
net AS (
 SELECT s.p, s.store_id, s.s - coalesce(r.r,0) n, s.s gross FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (p, store_id)),
lfl AS (
 SELECT c.store_id FROM net c JOIN net pr ON pr.store_id=c.store_id AND pr.p='prior' WHERE c.p='cur'
   AND c.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-05-31' AND closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-04-28' AND NOT (closure_end_date < DATE '2025-04-28'))
   AND c.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE close_date IS NOT NULL))
SELECT count(*) stores,
  sum(CASE WHEN p='cur' THEN n END) cur_net, sum(CASE WHEN p='prior' THEN n END) prior_net,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN p='cur' THEN n END)/sum(CASE WHEN p='prior' THEN n END)-1),3) lfl_pct,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN p='cur' THEN n END)/28/(sum(CASE WHEN p='prior' THEN n END)/27)-1),3) per_trading_day_pct,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN p='cur' THEN n END)/sum(CASE WHEN p='prior' THEN n END)-1),3) x,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN p='cur' AND store_id NOT IN (136,137) THEN n END)/sum(CASE WHEN p='prior' AND store_id NOT IN (136,137) THEN n END)-1),3) excl_new,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN p='cur' THEN gross END)/sum(CASE WHEN p='prior' THEN gross END)-1),3) before_returns_pct
FROM net WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl)

WITH days AS (
 SELECT c.calendar_date cur_date, p.calendar_date prior_date
 FROM dim_date c JOIN dim_date p ON p.calendar_date = c.calendar_date - INTERVAL 371 DAY
 WHERE c.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND c.fiscal_period=1 AND c.is_trading_day AND p.is_trading_day),
lfl AS (
 SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store
 WHERE store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL AND is_current
   AND coalesce(open_date, DATE '2000-01-01') <= DATE '2025-04-28'
   AND store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-04-28' AND closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-05-31')),
cur AS (
 SELECT sum(f.net_amount) s FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND f.sale_date IN (SELECT cur_date FROM days)),
curr AS (
 SELECT sum(r.refund_net) r FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND r.return_date IN (SELECT cur_date FROM days)),
pri AS (
 SELECT sum(f.net_amount) s FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND f.sale_date IN (SELECT prior_date FROM days)),
prir AS (
 SELECT sum(r.refund_net) r FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND r.return_date IN (SELECT prior_date FROM days)),
rr AS (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM days) ndays, (SELECT count(*) FROM lfl) nstores,
   (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date = DATE '2025-05-01') ret_on_closed,
   (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date = DATE '2025-05-01') sales_on_closed)
SELECT nstores, ndays, ret_on_closed, sales_on_closed, cur.s - curr.r cur_net, pri.s - prir.r prior_net,
  round(100*((cur.s-curr.r)/(pri.s-prir.r)-1),2) lfl_pct
FROM cur, curr, pri, prir, rr

calls.statement:
WITH days AS (
 SELECT c.calendar_date AS cur_date, p.calendar_date AS prior_date
 FROM dim_date c JOIN dim_date p ON p.calendar_date = c.calendar_date - INTERVAL 371 DAY
 WHERE c.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND c.fiscal_period = 1 AND c.is_trading_day AND p.is_trading_day),
lfl AS (
 SELECT store_id FROM dim_store
 WHERE store_id < 900 AND is_current AND close_date IS NULL
   AND coalesce(open_date, DATE '2000-01-01') <= DATE '2025-04-28'
   AND store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-04-28' AND closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-05-31')),
cur AS (
 SELECT (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND f.sale_date IN (SELECT cur_date FROM days))
      - (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND r.return_date IN (SELECT cur_date FROM days)) AS net),
pri AS (
 SELECT (SELECT sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND f.sale_date IN (SELECT prior_date FROM days))
      - (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND r.return_date IN (SELECT prior_date FROM days)) AS net)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, round(100 * (cur.net / pri.net - 1), 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct FROM cur, pri
